question: Should the experimental `claws update` executor land with fail-closed `update_partial` plus status/Doctor/manual recovery for uncertain external mutations, or should it wait for durable operation-identity reconciliation?
rationale: The implementation can truthfully preserve uncertain provenance, but the acceptable operator recovery guarantee after package or Gateway mutation is a product and lifecycle-contract choice rather than a mechanical code-review judgment.

options.title: Require live recovery proof now
options.body: Keep the current contract, but require exact-head proof of package and Gateway failure/retry plus status/Doctor recovery before merge.

options.title: Wait for durable reconciliation
options.body: Pause the executor until a stable operation identity and automatic reconcile/retry path can recover uncertain external mutations.

options.title: Accept manual recovery experimentally
options.body: Explicitly accept the documented manual status/Doctor recovery boundary for the gated experimental feature and merge after normal stacked-PR review.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof now
recommendation.body: Keep the current contract, but require exact-head proof of package and Gateway failure/retry plus status/Doctor recovery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the unresolved recovery-contract decision and the proof needed to support either acceptance or deferral.
